BallotDefinition.ActivationContest.description: For a contest containing an option that conditionally activates other contests on the ballot.This element uses ControllingContest as a superclass. Therefore, it inherits the attributes of Contest as well as ControllingContest.

BallotSubTitle.description: Subtitle of the contest as it appears on the ballot.

BallotTitle.description: Title of the contest as it appears on the ballot.

CandidateId.description: Link to a Candidate instance. For associating a candidate with the activation contest (e.g. a candidate subject to recall).

ContestOption.description: For associating contest options for the contest, e.g., candidates,  ballot measure options.

ControlledContestIds.description: A contest on a ballot whose state is dependent on the selections made in a separate controlling contest.

ElectionDistrictId.description: Link to a GpUnit instance. For associating the contest with a reporting unit that represents the geographical scope of the contest, e.g., a district, etc.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating an ID with the contest.

HasRotation.description: Boolean to indicate whether the selections in the contest are rotated. Assumed to be “no” if not present.

Name.description: Name of the contest, not necessarily as it appears on the ballot.

OtherVoteVariation.description: For use when VoteVariation is other.

SequenceOrder.description: Ordering for listing the contest for purposes of display.  If not present, no order is assumed.

SummaryText.description: For a summary on the ballot of the activation contest, e.g. "Should John Smith be recalled?".

TotalSubUnits.description: Total number of subunits, e.g., precincts that have this contest on the ballot.

VoteVariation.description: Vote variation associated with the contest, e.g., n-of-m.

BallotDefinition.ActivationOption.description: For the contest selections in an ActivationContest. It inherits the attributes of ContestOption.

CausesActivation.description: Boolean to indicate whether this selection, when chosen by the voter will cause controlled contests to activate.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating an ID with the contest option.

Selection.description: The text on the ballot associated with the selection.

SequenceOrder.description: Order in which the candidate is listed on the ballot for purposes of display. If not present, no order is assumed.

BallotDefinition.AnnotatedString.description: Used as a type for character strings; it adds a 32-character annotation to a character string. AnnotatedString is a subtype of string.

Annotation.description: An annotation of up to 32 characters associated with a character string.

BallotDefinition.AnnotatedUri.description: Used as a type for character strings that represent Uniform Resource Identifiers (URI); it adds a 32-character annotation to a character string.

Annotation.description: An annotation of up to 32 characters associated with a character string.

BallotDefinition.BallotDefinition.description:
For defining items pertaining to the issuer and version of the definition and when it was generated.

BallotDefinition references the major elements that are not necessarily specific to an election and that therefore can exist in a logical ballot definition: GpUnit, Office and OfficeGroup, Party, Person, and Election.

BallotFormat.description: For associating ballot formats with the definition.

Election.description: For associating elections with the definition.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating an ID with the definition.

GeneratedDate.description: Identifies the date and time that the ballot definition was generated.

GpUnit.description: For associating geopolitical units with the definition.

Header.description: For associating headers with parts of a ballot style.

IsTest.description: Used to indicate whether the definition is a test. Assumed to be “false” if not present.

IssuerAbbreviation.description: An abbreviation of the definition issuer such as the 2-character U.S. Census Bureau abbreviation of the state providing the election definition, e.g., AL, TX, MN, etc.

Notes.description: For including an arbitrary message with the definition.

Office.description: For associating offices with the definition.

OfficeGroup.description: For associating a name for a grouping of offices with the definition.

Party.description: For associating parties with the definition.

Person.description: For associating persons with the definition.

SequenceEnd.description: The upper bound of the sequence; e.g., “1” if there is only 1 report, “2” if there are two reports in the sequence, etc.

SequenceStart.description: The report's number as part of a sequence of reports, used with SequenceEnd so as to be read as, e.g., 1 of 1, 1 of 2, 2 of 2, etc.  Starts with "1".

Shape.description: For associating parts of the ballot with geometric shapes.

TestType.description: A description of the type of test, e.g., pre-election, logic and accuracy, etc.

VendorApplicationId.description: An identifier of the vendor application generating the ballot definition, e.g., X-EMS version 3.1.a.

Version.description: To identify the version of the BD specification being used, i.e., version 1.0.0. This will need to be updated for different versions of the specification.

BallotDefinition.BallotDefinitionVersion.description:
Values:
	1.0.0: For version 1.0.0 of this specification.

BallotDefinition.BallotFormat.description:
For providing details related to the concrete presentation of a ballot appropriate to the particular voting technology being used. All physical details of a ballot style are associated with a particular BallotFormat.

BallotFormat sets the MeasurementUnit appropriate for the marking surface used.

Application.description: The application that generates ballots in the ballot format.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating IDs with the ballot format.

FiducialMark.description: For associating a ballot format with one or more global fiducial marks appearing on a ballot.

LongEdge.description: Measurement of the long edge of the ballot sheet.

MeasurementUnit.description: The measurement units used to express locations of ballot content, such as contest option positions.

Orientation.description: Orientation of the page relative to the coordinate plane.

SelectionCaptureMethod.description: The method used to read contest selections or indications on the ballot.

ShortEdge.description: Measurement of the short edge of the ballot sheet.

mCDFArea.description: For locating the data encoded using a mCDF Profile (e.g. mCDF Profile for Contest Selection Capture).

BallotDefinition.BallotMeasureContest.description:
For ballot measure (i.e., referenda or a tax measure) and judicial retention contests. It inherits the attributes of Contest.

If the type of ballot measure is not listed in enumeration BallotMeasureType, use other and include the type (that is not listed in the enumeration) in OtherType.

BallotSubTitle.description: Subtitle of the contest as it appears on the ballot.

BallotTitle.description: Title of the contest as it appears on the ballot.

ConStatement.description: For a statement on the ballot associated with a “no” vote.

ContestOption.description: For associating contest options for the contest, e.g., candidates,  ballot measure options.

EffectOfAbstain.description: For a statement on the ballot detailing the effect of abstaining from voting on the ballot measure.

ElectionDistrictId.description: Link to a GpUnit instance. For associating the contest with a reporting unit that represents the geographical scope of the contest, e.g., a district, etc.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating an ID with the contest.

FullText.description: For full text on the ballot of the ballot measure.

HasRotation.description: Boolean to indicate whether the selections in the contest are rotated. Assumed to be “no” if not present.

InfoUri.description: For associating a URI with the ballot measure contest.

Name.description: Name of the contest, not necessarily as it appears on the ballot.

OtherVoteVariation.description: For use when VoteVariation is other.

PassageThreshold.description: For a statement on the ballot of the number or percentage of votes needed to approve or pass the ballot measure.

ProStatement.description: For a statement on the ballot associated with a “yes” vote.

SequenceOrder.description: Ordering for listing the contest for purposes of display.  If not present, no order is assumed.

SummaryText.description: For a summary on the ballot of the ballot measure.

TotalSubUnits.description: Total number of subunits, e.g., precincts that have this contest on the ballot.

Type.description: For indicating the type of ballot measure.

VoteVariation.description: Vote variation associated with the contest, e.g., n-of-m.

BallotDefinition.BallotMeasureOption.description: For a contest selection in a ballot measure contest. Because judicial or other retention contests are often treated like ballot measure contests, this element can be used also for retention contests. It inherits the attributes of ContestOption.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating an ID with the contest option.

Selection.description: Contains the text used to indicate a vote for or against the ballot measure, e.g., “yes”, “no”.

SequenceOrder.description: Order in which the candidate is listed on the ballot for purposes of display. If not present, no order is assumed.

BallotDefinition.BallotMeasureType.description:
Enumeration for types of ballot measures in the BallotMeasureContest element.
Values:
	ballot-measure: For a standard “yes” or “no” question on the ballot.
	initiative: For an initiative.
	other: Used when the type of ballot measure is not included in this enumeration.
	recall: For a recall.
	referendum: For a referendum.

BallotDefinition.BallotSideType.description:
The side of a ballot sheet.
Values:
	back: The back of the ballot sheet.
	front: The front of the ballot sheet

BallotDefinition.BallotStyle.description:
For defining a ballot style composed of ordered content (i.e. Headers or Contests) and their contest selections, and associating the ballot style with a political party, a reference to an image of the ballot, and a reference to a precinct or other geopolitical unit that the ballot is unique to. Election includes BallotStyle.
BallotStyle references OrderedContent to include content that appears on that ballot style. To preserve any rotation associated with the ballot, it is expected that the generating application will list the occurrences of OrderedContest in the order as on the ballot for the associated geopolitical unit.
BallotStyle references one or more GpUnit instances defined for the associated precincts or split precincts. If the ballot style is associated with multiple precincts (or other geographies), multiple references to the precinct GpUnit instances can be included.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating IDs with the ballot style.

GpUnitIds.description: Unique identifier for one or more GpUnit instances.  For associating specific election administrative areas (e.g. precincts or splits) with the ballot style.

ImageUri.description: URI for a sample ballot image.

Language.description: For the written languages appearing on the ballot style.

OrderedContent.description: For associating a ballot style with ballot content, such as contests or headers.

PartyIds.description: For associating one or more parties with the ballot style.

Purpose.description: Freeform text to further describe the purpose (e.g. federal-only ballot) of the ballot style.

BallotDefinition.BoundedObject.description:
A class representing a bounding box. The box represents in absolute coordinate space its location and size. Its location is given by x,y coordinates, size by h,w values, the side of the sheet it appears on and the sheet number of the ballot style.

PhysicalContest includes BoundedObject.
BoundedObject has three subclasses, used contextually:

FiducialMark, included by BallotFormat

mCDFArea, included by BallotFormat

OptionPosition, included by PhysicalContestOption

WriteInPosition, included by PhysicalContestOption

H.description: Height in ballot format measurement units.

Sheet.description: The ballot sheet the bounded object appears on. Sheets start at 1 and increase monotonically. Does not apply to mCDFArea, or global fiducials.

Side.description: The side of the sheet of paper the bounded object appears.

W.description: Width in ballot format measurement units.

X.description: X-coordinate for locating a bounded object (top left anchor).

Y.description: Y-coordinate for locating a bounded object (top left anchor).

BallotDefinition.Candidate.description:
For defining information about a candidate in a contest. CandidateOption references Candidate instances to associate one or more candidates with a contest selection. Election includes Candidate.

Candidate uses the Party association to reference the candidate's political party. If the candidate is endorsed by other parties for a particular contest, the endorsing parties are referenced using the CandidateOption attribute.

ExternalIdentifier can be used to associate IDs with the candidate. If the type is not listed in enumeration IdentifierType, use other and include the type (that is not listed in the enumeration) in OtherType.

BallotName.description: For the candidate’s name as listed on the ballot.

CampaignSlogan.description: The slogan or motto used by the candidate in their campaign.

ContactInformation.description: For associating contact information for the candidate.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating IDs with the candidate.

FileDate.description: Date when the candidate filed for the contest.

IsIncumbent.description: Boolean to indicate whether the candidate is the incumbent for the office associated with the contest. Assumed to be “false” if not present.

IsTopTicket.description: Boolean to indicate whether the candidate is the top of a ticket that includes multiple candidates. Assumed to be “false” if not present.

PartyId.description: For associating a party with the candidate.

PersonId.description: For associating more detailed information about the candidate.

PreElectionStatus.description: Registration status of the candidate, e.g., filed, qualified, etc.

ReadName.description: The name spelled phonetically for reading by a screen reader.

BallotDefinition.CandidateContest.description:
For a contest that involves selecting one or more candidates. It inherits the attributes of Contest.

This class optionally references Office and Party. If the candidate contest is associated with a ticket (of candidates) and each candidate in the ticket is associated with a separate office, the association to Office can reference each of the separate offices. For example, if the contest is for the state governor ticket but Governor and Lieutenant (Lt.) Governor are both separate offices, the association references first to the Office instance defined for the Governor's office and then to the Lt. Governor's office. In this case, it is expected that the generating application will list the multiple references according to a jurisdiction-defined ordering scheme, e.g., Governor first and Lt. Governor second.

Note that when using the CandidateOption class to associate the candidates with a contest selection for the contest, the order of the candidates should match the order of offices. Again, using the example of the state governor ticket, if the offices are listed with Governor first and Lt. Governor second, then the order of the candidates in the ContestOption instance should be identical, with the Governor candidate first and the Lt. Governor candidate second.

BallotSubTitle.description: Subtitle of the contest as it appears on the ballot.

BallotTitle.description: Title of the contest as it appears on the ballot.

ContestOption.description: For associating contest options for the contest, e.g., candidates,  ballot measure options.

ElectionDistrictId.description: Link to a GpUnit instance. For associating the contest with a reporting unit that represents the geographical scope of the contest, e.g., a district, etc.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating an ID with the contest.

HasRotation.description: Boolean to indicate whether the selections in the contest are rotated. Assumed to be “no” if not present.

Name.description: Name of the contest, not necessarily as it appears on the ballot.

NumberElected.description: Number of candidates that are elected in the contest (“n” of n-of-m).

NumberRunoff.description: The number of candidates in a runoff contest.

OtherVoteVariation.description: For use when VoteVariation is other.

PrimaryPartyIds.description: For associating parties with the contest.

RanksAllowed.description: Maximum number of ranks per voter in this contest.

SequenceOrder.description: Ordering for listing the contest for purposes of display.  If not present, no order is assumed.

TotalSubUnits.description: Total number of subunits, e.g., precincts that have this contest on the ballot.

VoteVariation.description: Vote variation associated with the contest, e.g., n-of-m.

VotesAllowed.description: Maximum number of votes per voter in this contest.

BallotDefinition.CandidateOption.description:
For the contest selections in a candidate contest, including for write-ins. It inherits the attributes of ContestOption. References to multiple Candidate instances can be included if necessary, e.g., when the contest selection would be for a ticket of candidates (unless the ticket itself is defined as a candidate).

EndorsementParty is used to reference any associated endorsement parties other than the specific party of the candidate (Candidate references Party for that purpose). For example, if a candidate of one party is also endorsed by a second party, use EndorsementParty to reference the second party. A second example would be for ballot fusion as used in some states, where the same candidate is listed multiple times in the same contest, but with different endorsement parties.

When multiple candidates are referenced for a ticket and the ordering of the candidates is important to preserve, it is expected that the generating application will list the references to Candidate instances according to the ordering scheme in place. For example, if the contest is for a ticket in which each candidate is associated with a different office, then the order of the candidates should match the same ordering of the <Office> element references within <OfficeIds> in the <Contest xsi:type="CandidateContest" ... /> element.

CandidateIds.description: For associating a candidate with the candidate selection on the ballot and for cases where the contest selection is for multiple candidates, e.g., a ticket.

EndorsementPartyIds.description: For associating one or more endorsing parties with the candidate selection.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating an ID with the contest option.

IsWriteIn.description: Indicates whether the candidate is a write-in, e.g., true or false. Assumed to be false if not present.

SequenceOrder.description: Order in which the candidate is listed on the ballot for purposes of display. If not present, no order is assumed.

BallotDefinition.CandidatePreElectionSta.description:
Enumeration for various pre-election statuses applicable to a candidate
      in the Candidate
      class.
Values:
	filed: For candidates who have filed with the election authority but not necessarily qualified.
	qualified: For candidates who are qualified by the election authority to be on the ballot for a contest.
	withdrawn: For candidates who have withdrawn from the contest.

BallotDefinition.Coalition.description:
For defining a coalition, i.e., a collection of parties organized for the purpose of endorsing a candidate in a contest. It inherits the properties of Party.

Coalition instances themselves are composed of multiple Party references along with a reference to an associated Contests.

If there are no associated Contests, a general default is that the coalition endorses the associated parties.

Abbreviation.description: Short name for the party, e.g., “DEM”.

Color.description: For associating an HTML RGB color coding with the party.

ContactInformation.description: For associating contact information regarding the party, e.g., party offices.

ContestIds.description: For associating contests with the coalition.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating IDs with the party.

IsRecognizedParty.description: For indicating whether the party is recognized by the election authority; “false” is assumed if not present.

LogoUri.description: A URI to the party’s graphical logo.

Name.description: Official full name of the party, e.g., “Republican”; can appear on the ballot.

PartyIds.description: For associating parties with the coalition.

PartyScopeGpUnitIds.description: The GpUnit(s) the party operates in or the top-most GpUnit.

Slogan.description: The slogan or motto used by a political party.

BallotDefinition.ContactInformation.description:
For defining contact information about objects such as persons, boards of authorities, organizations, etc. Election, ElectionAdministration, Person, GpUnit, and Office include ContactInformation.

To include an address for the contact, use multiple occurrences of AddressLine. It is expected that the generating application will list the name of the person/organization in the first occurrence of AddressLine, with subsequent ordered occurrences for street address, city, state, zip code, etc. Directions can be used to supply any additional address-related information that may appear in multiple languages.

ContactInformation includes LatLng so as to associate latitude/longitude with the contact address.

Email, Fax, and Phone are of type AnnotatedString, which permits up to a 32-character annotation to be associated with the data.

AddressLine.description: For associating an address with the contact.

Directions.description: Directional information in addition to address information.

Email.description: Email address associated with the contact.

Fax.description: Fax number associated with the contact.

Label.description: For use as needed and compatibility with the VIP schema.

LatLng.description: For latitude and longitude information associated with the contact.

Phone.description: Phone number associated with the contact.

Schedule.description: For associating a schedule with the contact.

BallotDefinition.DayType.description:
Enumeration for the day(s) in a schedule in the Schedule element.
Values:
	all: Used for all days of the week.
	friday: Used if day of week is Friday.
	monday: Used if day of week is Monday.
	saturday: Used if day of week is Saturday.
	sunday: Used if day of week is Sunday.
	thursday: Used if day of week is Thursday.
	tuesday: Used if day of week is Tuesday.
	wednesday: Used if day of week is Wednesday.
	weekday: Used for any day of the week except Saturday and Sunday.
	weekend: Used for both Saturday and Sunday.

BallotDefinition.Election.description:
For defining details of the election and associated information such as candidates and contests.

Election includes links to the major instances that are specific to an election: BallotStyle, Candidate, and Contest.

Election includes a required reference to ElectionScope, which links to a GpUnit instance for the purpose of identifying the geographical scope of the election. For example, for an election within a county, ElectionScope would reference a GpUnit defined for the county. If it is desired to include election authority information, the GpUnit can include ElectionAdministration.

BallotStyle.description: For defining ballot styles associated with the election.

Candidate.description: For defining candidates associated with the election.

ContactInformation.description: For associating various contact information with the election.

Contest.description: For defining contests associated with the election.

ElectionScopeId.description: Unique identifier for a GpUnit element. For associating the election with a reporting unit that represents the geographical scope of the election, e.g., a state, a county, etc.

EndDate.description: Calendar end date of the election; for a typical one-day election, the end date is the same as the start date.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating IDs with the election.

Name.description: For including a name for the election; the name could be the same name as appears on the ballot.

StartDate.description: Calendar start date of the election, e.g., “2018-11-04”.

Type.description: Enumerated type of election, e.g., partisan-primary, open-primary, etc.

BallotDefinition.ElectionAdministration.description:
Used to provide various information about an election authority. ReportingUnit includes ElectionAdministration.

ElectionAdministration includes ContactInformation for the election authority and, using ElectionOfficialPerson references one or more Person instances defined for individuals/organizations associated with the election authority.

ElectionOfficialPersonIds.description: Unique identifier for one or more Person instances defined for the election authority.

BallotDefinition.ElectionType.description:
Enumeration for the type of election in the BallotDefinition class.
Values:
	general: Election in which all eligible voters, regardless of party affiliation, are permitted to select candidates to fill public office and/or vote on ballot measures.
	other: Used when the election type is not listed in this enumeration.
	partisan-primary-closed: Primary election in which the voter receives a ballot containing only those party-specific contests pertaining to the political party with which the voter is affiliated, along with non-party-specific contests presented at the same election. Unaffiliated voters may be permitted to vote only on non-party-specific contests.
	partisan-primary-open: Primary election in which the voter may choose a political party at the time of voting and vote in party-specific contests associated with that party, along with non-party-specific contests presented at the same election. Some states require voters to publicly declare their choice of party at the polling place, after which the election worker provides or activates the appropriate ballot. Other states allow the voters to make their choice of party within the privacy of the voting booth.
	primary: Election held to determine which candidates qualify to appear as contest options in subsequent elections.
	runoff: Election to select a winner following a primary or a general election, in which no candidate in the contest received the required minimum percentage of the votes cast. The two candidates receiving the most votes for the contest in question proceed to a runoff election.
	special: Primary or general election that is not regularly scheduled. A special election may be combined with a scheduled election.

BallotDefinition.ExternalIdentifier.description:
For associating a jurisdiction's codes, i.e., identifiers, with objects such as candidates, offices, or geopolitical units such as counties, towns, precincts, etc. Multiple occurrences of ExternalIdentifier can be used to associate multiple codes, e.g., if there is a desire to associate multiple codes with a particular object such as FIPS (Federal Information Processing Standard) codes as well as OCD-IDs (Open Civic Data Identifiers).

For elements that link to ExternalIdentifier instances, if the type is not listed in enumeration IdentifierType, use other and include the type (that is not listed in the enumeration) in OtherType.

Label.description: For use as needed and compatibility with the VIP schema.

OtherType.description: Used when IdentifierType value is other.

Value.description: The identifier used by the jurisdiction.

BallotDefinition.FiducialMark.description: FiducialMark is a subclass of BoundedObject for geometry found at fixed positions of the page. BallotFormat references FiducialMark for geometry found at fixed locations on the ballot. PhysicalContest references FiducialMark for geometry proximate to the contest.

H.description: Height in ballot format measurement units.

ShapeId.description: For associating a FiducialMark with the geometric shape that represents it.

Sheet.description: The ballot sheet the bounded object appears on. Sheets start at 1 and increase monotonically. Does not apply to mCDFArea, or global fiducials.

Side.description: The side of the sheet of paper the bounded object appears.

W.description: Width in ballot format measurement units.

X.description: X-coordinate for locating a bounded object (top left anchor).

Y.description: Y-coordinate for locating a bounded object (top left anchor).

BallotDefinition.GeoSpatialFormat.description:
Enumeration for geospatial vector data formats used in Geographic Information System (GIS) software, used in the SpatialExtent class.
Values:
	geo-json: For GeoJSON open standard format.
	gml: For Geography Markup Language format.
	kml: For Keyhole Markup Language format.
	shp: For the shape file format associated with Esri.
	wkt: For Well-known Text format.

BallotDefinition.Header.description: For defining a reusable set of headers.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating an ID with the header.

HeaderedContent.description: For textual content appearing under a header (e.g. ballot instructions).

Name.description: Name of the header, as it is to appear on a ballot style.

BallotDefinition.Hours.description: Hours is used to specify a specific day and hours on that day, including the time zone.  Multiple occurrences of Hours can be used if the schedule includes a range of days and hours.

Label.description: For use as needed and compatibility with the VIP schema.

BallotDefinition.IdentifierType.description:
Enumeration for election data-related codes in the ExternalIdentifier class .
Values:
	fips: For FIPS codes.
	local-level: For a code that is specific to a county or other similar locality.
	national-level: For a code that is used at the national level other than “fips” or “ocd-id”.
	ocd-id: For Open Civic Data identifiers.
	other: Used when the type of code is not included in this enumeration.
	state-level: For a code that is specific to a state.

BallotDefinition.InternationalizedText.description:
For strings that can contain multi-national text, for use with text as shown on a ballot containing multi-national text. The label attribute can be used to assign an identifier to the text as desired.

Text uses the xsd:language type such that its language attribute must be set to a value that identifies the language.

Values for language are from ISO 639 [12] and include:

en – English

en-US – U.S. English

en-GB – U.K. English

fr – French

es – Spanish

zh – Chinese

ja – Japanese

ko – Korean

Label.description: For use as needed and compatibility with the VIP schema.

Text.description: Used to hold a string of text with an associated table indicating the language used.

BallotDefinition.LanguageString.description: Used to hold a string of text with an associated table indicating the language used.

Content.description: The string in the specified language.

Language.description: Identification of the language, such as 'es'.

BallotDefinition.LatLng.description: Associates latitude/longitude with a contact address.

Label.description: For use as needed and compatibility with the VIP schema.

Source.description: System used to perform the lookup from location name to lat/lng, e.g., the name of a geocoding service.

BallotDefinition.MeasurementUnitType.description:
The measurement unit for describing the location of content on a ballot.
Values:
	in: inches
	mm: millimeters
	pc: picas
	pt: points (1/72 inch)

BallotDefinition.Office.description:
For defining an office and information associated with a contest and/or a district. BallotDefinition includes Office. CandidateContest and RetentionContest reference Office.

Office includes Term for defining details about the term of an office such as start/end dates and the type of term. OfficeGroup is included from BallotDefinition to assign a name to a grouping of office definitions.

Office includes an optional ElectionDistrict reference to a GpUnit for the purpose of identifying the geographical scope of the office. For example, for an office for a state senate seat, ElectionDistrict would include a reference to the GpUnit defined for the district associated with that office.

ContactInformation.description: For associating various contact information with the office.

Description.description: A description of the office, possibly as shown on the ballot to the voter.

ElectionDistrictId.description: Link to a GpUnit instance. For associating the office with a reporting unit that represents the geographical scope of the contest, e.g., a district, etc.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating IDs with the office.

FilingDeadline.description: Date and time when a candidate must have filed for the contest for the office.

IsPartisan.description: Boolean to indicate whether the office is partisan, e.g., true or false.  If not present, assumption is true.

Name.description: Name of the office; can appear on the ballot.

OfficeHolderPersonIds.description: Links to one or more Person instances defined for the office holder.

BallotDefinition.OfficeGroup.description: Used to assign a name to a grouping of office definitions. It includes references to Office instances and a name to identify the grouping of references, e.g., "Judicial" or "Statewide", etc. SubOfficeGroup can be used to create a nested hierarchy of groupings. BallotDefinition includes OfficeGroup.

Label.description: For use as needed and compatibility with the VIP schema.

OfficeIds.description: Link to one or more Office instances.

SubOfficeGroup.description: For defining a nested hierarchy of Office instance groupings.

BallotDefinition.OfficeTermType.description:
Enumeration for the office term type in the Office class.
Values:
	full-term: When the officeholder’s term began at the beginning of the full term of the office, e.g., 6 years for U.S. Senate.
	unexpired-term: When the officeholder’s term began at some date after the beginning of the full term of the office, generally because the previous officeholder vacated the office before the fullterm expired.

BallotDefinition.OptionPosition.description: For associating a physical contest option to the location(s) where a selection can be indicated. It inherits the properties of BoundedObject.

FractionalVotes.description: The proper fractional number of votes represented by the option position.

H.description: Height in ballot format measurement units.

IndicatorId.description: For associating an OptionPosition with the shape that conveys the expected location of a mark.

NumberVotes.description: The number of votes represented by the option position.

Rank.description: The rank represented by the option position, if a RCV contest.

Sheet.description: The ballot sheet the bounded object appears on. Sheets start at 1 and increase monotonically. Does not apply to mCDFArea, or global fiducials.

Side.description: The side of the sheet of paper the bounded object appears.

W.description: Width in ballot format measurement units.

BallotDefinition.OrderedContest.description: For the appearance of a contest on a particular ballot style.This property uses OrderedContent as a superclass.

ContestId.description: The contest associated represented by OrderedContest.

OrderedContestOptionIds.description: The contest selections for the ballot.

Physical.description: For describing the physical aspects of the contest.

BallotDefinition.OrderedHeader.description: For the appearance of a header on a particular ballot style.This property uses OrderedContent as a superclass.

HeaderId.description: Association to the header to be used.

OrderedContent.description: For associating a header with ballot content, such as contests or nested headers.

BallotDefinition.OrientationType.description:
The orientation of a ballot sheet.
Values:
	landscape: Orient the sheet so that the ballot content print across the long edge of the paper.
	portrait: Orient the sheet so that the ballot content print across the short edge of the paper.

BallotDefinition.Party.description:
Used to describe a political party that can then be referenced in other elements. BallotDefinition includes Party. Candidate, PartyRegistration, and Person reference Party.

Party is an abstract type with one subtype Coalition, used to define coalitions.

The Color attribute specifies a 6-digit RGB code displayable using HTML.

Abbreviation.description: Short name for the party, e.g., “DEM”.

Color.description: For associating an HTML RGB color coding with the party.

ContactInformation.description: For associating contact information regarding the party, e.g., party offices.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating IDs with the party.

IsRecognizedParty.description: For indicating whether the party is recognized by the election authority; “false” is assumed if not present.

LogoUri.description: A URI to the party’s graphical logo.

Name.description: Official full name of the party, e.g., “Republican”; can appear on the ballot.

PartyScopeGpUnitIds.description: The GpUnit(s) the party operates in or the top-most GpUnit.

Slogan.description: The slogan or motto used by a political party.

BallotDefinition.PartyContest.description:
Use PartyContest for a contest that where voters choose a party on the ballot. When a selection in this contest causes other indirect selections, StraightPartyContest should be used instead.

It inherits the attributes of Contest.

BallotSubTitle.description: Subtitle of the contest as it appears on the ballot.

BallotTitle.description: Title of the contest as it appears on the ballot.

ContestOption.description: For associating contest options for the contest, e.g., candidates,  ballot measure options.

ElectionDistrictId.description: Link to a GpUnit instance. For associating the contest with a reporting unit that represents the geographical scope of the contest, e.g., a district, etc.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating an ID with the contest.

HasRotation.description: Boolean to indicate whether the selections in the contest are rotated. Assumed to be “no” if not present.

Name.description: Name of the contest, not necessarily as it appears on the ballot.

OtherVoteVariation.description: For use when VoteVariation is other.

SequenceOrder.description: Ordering for listing the contest for purposes of display.  If not present, no order is assumed.

TotalSubUnits.description: Total number of subunits, e.g., precincts that have this contest on the ballot.

VoteVariation.description: Vote variation associated with the contest, e.g., n-of-m.

BallotDefinition.PartyOption.description: For a contest selection involving a party such as for a party list selection or straight party selection on the ballot. It inherits the attributes of ContestOption.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating an ID with the contest option.

PartyIds.description: Link to one or more Party instances. For associating one or more parties with the party selection.

SequenceOrder.description: Order in which the candidate is listed on the ballot for purposes of display. If not present, no order is assumed.

BallotDefinition.PartyPreferenceContest.description: For a controlling contest that may appear on an open primary ballot and allows the voter to select which political party's primary they wish to vote. A valid selection in this contest protects the voter from voiding the partisan selection of the ballot by making selections in more than one party's contest.This element uses ControllingContest as a superclass. Therefore, it inherits the attributes of Contest as well as ControllingContest.

BallotSubTitle.description: Subtitle of the contest as it appears on the ballot.

BallotTitle.description: Title of the contest as it appears on the ballot.

ContestOption.description: For associating contest options for the contest, e.g., candidates,  ballot measure options.

ControlledContestIds.description: A contest on a ballot whose state is dependent on the selections made in a separate controlling contest.

ElectionDistrictId.description: Link to a GpUnit instance. For associating the contest with a reporting unit that represents the geographical scope of the contest, e.g., a district, etc.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating an ID with the contest.

HasRotation.description: Boolean to indicate whether the selections in the contest are rotated. Assumed to be “no” if not present.

Name.description: Name of the contest, not necessarily as it appears on the ballot.

OtherVoteVariation.description: For use when VoteVariation is other.

SequenceOrder.description: Ordering for listing the contest for purposes of display.  If not present, no order is assumed.

TotalSubUnits.description: Total number of subunits, e.g., precincts that have this contest on the ballot.

VoteVariation.description: Vote variation associated with the contest, e.g., n-of-m.

BallotDefinition.PartyRegistration.description: For tracking the number of registered voters per party per geopolitical unit, i.e., for reporting on the number of registered voters of a particular party in a district or other type of reporting unit. Referenced by GpUnit.

Count.description: A count for tracking the number of registered voters.

PartyId.description: Link to a Party instance. For associating a political party.

BallotDefinition.Person.description:
For defining information about a person; the person may be a candidate, election official, authority for a reporting unit, etc. BallotDefinition includes Person. Candidate, ElectionAdministration and
GpUnit references Person. Person optionally references ContactInformation for associating contact information.

Multiple occurrences of the MiddleName attribute can be used as needed, e.g., for names such as "John Andrew Winston Smith".

ContactInformation.description: For associating contact information with the person.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating IDs with the person.

PartyId.description: Links to a Party instance. For associating a political party with the person.

Prefix.description: A prefix associated with the person, e.g., Mr.

Suffix.description: A suffix associated with the person, e.g., Jr.

Title.description: A title associated with the person.

BallotDefinition.PhysicalContest.description: For the appearance of a contest on a particular ballot style with physical details such as the locations and shapes of contest option positions.

BallotFormatId.description: For associating a ballot format with a physical contest.

Extent.description: The extent of the contest. If the contest spans multiple sections of the ballot (e.g. columns or pages), then multiple extents may be provided.

FiducialMark.description: For associating a ordered physical contest with one or more local fiducial marks appearing near the contest.

PhysicalContestOption.description: The contest options associated with the contest, including physical details.

BallotDefinition.PhysicalContestOption.description: For associating a ContestOption to its physical manifestation. Each PhysicalContestOption is specified in terms of a particular BallotFormat. A PhysicalContestOption may have multiple OptionPosition instances, for voting methods that require it (e.g. rank choice voting). WriteInPosition specifies the response area where name(s) may written-in.

ContestOptionId.description: For associating a PhysicalContestOption with a ContestOption. This should always be provided unless the contest option is for a write-in.

OptionPosition.description: For defining locations where a selection can be indicated.

WriteInPosition.description: For defining locations where a name can be hand-written.

BallotDefinition.ReportingUnit.description:
For defining a geopolitical unit such as state, county, township, precinct, etc., using the ReportingUnitType enumeration. It inherits the attributes of GpUnit.

This class optionally references Person to associate one or more individuals, e.g., authorities, for the reporting unit. It also includes ContactInformation to provide contact addresses for the reporting unit, such as an address of a vote center.

Election references this class so as to identify the geographical scope of the election. In this case, the GpUnit element defined for the scope of the election may include ElectionAdministration to include election authority-related information.

The Type attribute uses the ReportingUnitType enumeration to specify the type of geopolitical geography being defined. ReportingUnitType contains the most common types of geographies, e.g., state, county, precinct, and so forth. If the reporting unit type is not listed in enumeration ReportingUnitType, use other and include the reporting unit type (that is not listed in the enumeration) in OtherType.

The IsDistricted boolean can be used in a number of ways. It is not strictly necessary, as it is possible to identify districts by their Type attribute or by examining the Contest instance's ElectionDistrict reference, which links to the election district associated with the contest. However, if a district is defined but is not linked from a contest, or if the type of district is not listed in the ReportingUnitType enumeration and therefore OtherType is used, then IsDistricted is necessary to identify the GpUnit as a district. The IsDistricted boolean can also be used to signify that a GpUnit defined as a jurisdiction, e.g., a county, is also used as a district for, e.g., county-wide contests.

AuthorityIds.description: A link to one or more Person instances describing an authority responsible for the reporting unit.

ComposingGpUnitIds.description: Unique identifier for one or more GpUnit instances.  For creating a reference to another GpUnit that is contained with the parent GpUnit.

ContactInformation.description: For associating contact information with the reporting unit.

ElectionAdministration.description: For use when the reporting unit serves as the authority in the election.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating an ID with the GpUnit, e.g., a district’s or county’s code.

IsDistricted.description: Boolean to indicate whether the reporting unit is a district; assumed to be “false” if not present.

IsMailOnly.description: Boolean to indicate whether the reporting unit handles only mail-in or absentee ballot elections, assumed to be “false” if not present.

Number.description: A number associated with the reporting unit; for compatibility with VIP.

OtherType.description: For use when ReportingUnitType value is other.

PartyRegistration.description: For associating a count of registered voters per party with the geopolitical unit.

SpatialDimension.description: For describing the reporting unit’s spatial extent (a polygon that shows the related area).

TotalSubUnits.description: Total number of associated subunits such as precincts.

Type.description: Enumerated type of reporting unit, e.g., state, county, district, precinct, etc.

VotersRegistered.description: Number of registered voters residing within the boundaries of the geopolitical unit.

BallotDefinition.ReportingUnitType.description:
Enumeration for the type of geopolitical unit in the ReportingUnit class.
Values:
	ballot-batch: Used for reporting batches of ballots that may cross precinct boundaries.
	ballot-style-area: Used for ballot style areas generally composed of precincts.
	borough: Used in CT, NJ, PA, other states, and New York City for boroughs. For AK and LA, see county.
	city: Used for a city that reports results and/or for the district that encompasses it.
	city-council: Used for city council districts.
	combined-precinct: Used for one or more precincts that have been combined for the purposes of reporting. Used for “Ward” if “Ward” is used interchangeably with “CombinedPrecinct”.
	congressional: Used for U.S. Congressional districts.
	country: Used for a reporting unit of type country.
	county: Used for a county and/or for the district that encompasses it. In AK, used for counties that are called boroughs. In LA, used for parishes.
	county-council: Used for county council districts.
	drop-box: Used for a dropbox for absentee ballots.
	judicial: Used for judicial districts.
	municipality: Used as applicable for various units such as towns, townships, villages that report votes and/or for the district that encompasses it.
	other: Used for other types of reporting units not included in this enumeration.
	polling-place: Used for a polling place.
	precinct: Used also for “Ward” or “District” when these terms are used interchangeably with “Precinct”.
	school: Used for a school district.
	special: Used for a special district.
	split-precinct: Used for splits of precincts.
	state: Used for a state and/or for the district that encompasses it.
	state-house: Used for a state house or assembly district.
	state-senate: Used for a state senate district.
	town: Used in some New England states as a type of municipality that reports votes and/or for the district that encompasses it.
	township: Used in some mid-western states as a type of municipality that reports votes and/or for the district that encompasses it.
	utility: Used for a utility district.
	village: Used as a type of municipality that reports votes and/or for the district that encompasses it.
	vote-center: Used for a vote center.
	ward: Used for combinations or groupings of precincts or other units.
	water: Used for a water district.

BallotDefinition.RetentionContest.description:
For judicial retention or other types of retention contests. Retention contests can be treated essentially as ballot measure contests, however this element differs from
BallotMeasureContest in that it can include a reference to a candidate or the associated office.

This element uses BallotMeasureContest as a superclass. Therefore, it inherits the attributes of Contest as well as BallotMeasureContest.

BallotSubTitle.description: Subtitle of the contest as it appears on the ballot.

BallotTitle.description: Title of the contest as it appears on the ballot.

CandidateId.description: Link to a Candidate instance. For associating a candidate with the retention contest.

ConStatement.description: For a statement on the ballot associated with a “no” vote.

ContestOption.description: For associating contest options for the contest, e.g., candidates,  ballot measure options.

EffectOfAbstain.description: For a statement on the ballot detailing the effect of abstaining from voting on the ballot measure.

ElectionDistrictId.description: Link to a GpUnit instance. For associating the contest with a reporting unit that represents the geographical scope of the contest, e.g., a district, etc.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating an ID with the contest.

FullText.description: For full text on the ballot of the ballot measure.

HasRotation.description: Boolean to indicate whether the selections in the contest are rotated. Assumed to be “no” if not present.

InfoUri.description: For associating a URI with the ballot measure contest.

Name.description: Name of the contest, not necessarily as it appears on the ballot.

OfficeId.description: Link to an Office instance. For associating an office description with the retention contest.

OtherVoteVariation.description: For use when VoteVariation is other.

PassageThreshold.description: For a statement on the ballot of the number or percentage of votes needed to approve or pass the ballot measure.

ProStatement.description: For a statement on the ballot associated with a “yes” vote.

SequenceOrder.description: Ordering for listing the contest for purposes of display.  If not present, no order is assumed.

SummaryText.description: For a summary on the ballot of the ballot measure.

TotalSubUnits.description: Total number of subunits, e.g., precincts that have this contest on the ballot.

Type.description: For indicating the type of ballot measure.

VoteVariation.description: Vote variation associated with the contest, e.g., n-of-m.

BallotDefinition.Schedule.description: For defining a schedule associated with a particular election office or location. ContactInformation includes Schedule.

EndDate.description: For the ending date of the schedule.

Hours.description: For specifying a range of hours for a schedule.

IsOnlyByAppointment.description: If an appointment is only by appointment; assumed to be “no” if not present.

IsOrByAppointment.description: If an appointment can by appointment presumably as desired; assumed to be “no” if not present.

IsSubjectToChange.description: If an appointment may be subject to change; assumed to be “no” if not present.

Label.description: For use as needed and compatibility with the VIP schema.

StartDate.description: For the starting date of the schedule.

BallotDefinition.SelectionCaptureMethod.description:
Values:
	mcdf: For a read method that uses the mCDF encoded using a symbology.
	omr: For a read method that uses optical mark recognition.

BallotDefinition.Shape.description:
For defining a geometric shape. Geometry can be used to represent content on a physical ballot style, such as for associating an OptionPosition to its shape. It is also used by FiducialMark to define the shape it takes..

Strokes when applied, are applied evenhanded.

FillColor.description: For fiducial marks only. If not specified, no fill is assumed.

StrokeColor.description: The color of the stroke. If no color is specified, assume black (what XFA does)

StrokeWidth.description: The width of the stroke in the measurement units of the BallotFormat associated with the PhysicalContest.

BallotDefinition.ShapeType.description:
Values:
	ellipse: For an ellipse shape
	rectangle: For a rectangle shape

BallotDefinition.SpatialDimension.description: For defining the spatial layout of a GpUnit, e.g., a map or a spatial extent (a polygon that shows the related area) for various purposes, including to visualize election results, to understand the composition of districts, or to determine whether GpUnit instances are properly related. GpUnit includes SpatialDimension.

MapUri.description: Typically a URI to a map of the GpUnit.

SpatialExtent.description:
For associating a GpUnit
      element’s spatial extent information.

BallotDefinition.SpatialExtent.description: SpatialDimension includes SpatialExtent for defining a GpUnit instance's spatial extent data and the format used for the spatial extent.

Coordinates.description: The data coordinates constituting the spatial extent.

Format.description: Enumerated type for the format used, e.g., gml, kml, wkt, etc.

BallotDefinition.StraightPartyContest.description: For a contest that involves choosing a party, typically for a straight party selection on the ballot.This element uses ControllingContest as a superclass. Therefore, it inherits the attributes of Contest as well as ControllingContest.

BallotSubTitle.description: Subtitle of the contest as it appears on the ballot.

BallotTitle.description: Title of the contest as it appears on the ballot.

ContestOption.description: For associating contest options for the contest, e.g., candidates,  ballot measure options.

ControlledContestIds.description: A contest on a ballot whose state is dependent on the selections made in a separate controlling contest.

ElectionDistrictId.description: Link to a GpUnit instance. For associating the contest with a reporting unit that represents the geographical scope of the contest, e.g., a district, etc.

ExternalIdentifier.description: For associating an ID with the contest.

HasRotation.description: Boolean to indicate whether the selections in the contest are rotated. Assumed to be “no” if not present.

Name.description: Name of the contest, not necessarily as it appears on the ballot.

OtherStraightPartyRuleset.description: For use when StraightPartyRuleset value is other.

OtherVoteVariation.description: For use when VoteVariation is other.

SequenceOrder.description: Ordering for listing the contest for purposes of display.  If not present, no order is assumed.

StraightPartyRuleset.description: The ruleset specifying how to consider indications made in the controlled contests.

TotalSubUnits.description: Total number of subunits, e.g., precincts that have this contest on the ballot.

VoteVariation.description: Vote variation associated with the contest, e.g., n-of-m.

BallotDefinition.StraightPartyRuleset.description:
Specifies how to consider indications made in the controlled contests of a straight party controlling contest.These specify the consequences direct selections made by the voter in controlled contests.
Values:
	exclusive: For a ruleset that excludes any straight-party selections if there is a directly selected candidate in a contest.
	inclusive: For a ruleset allowing any additional candidates selected by the straight-party to be included with directly selected candidates if the total number of candidates does not exceed the number of selections allowed.
	other: Used when the straight party rule type is not included in this enumeration.

BallotDefinition.Term.description: For describing information about an office term. Term is included by Office.

EndDate.description: End date for the current term of the office.

Label.description: For use as needed and compatibility with the VIP schema.

StartDate.description: Start date for the current term of the office.

Type.description: Enumerated type of term, e.g., full-term, unexpired-term, etc.

BallotDefinition.VoteVariation.description:
Enumeration for contest decision algorithm or rules in the Contest element.
Values:
	approval: When voter can select as many candidates as desired in a contest up to a maximum number.
	borda: For the Borda count voting.
	cumulative: When voter can allocate more than one vote to a given candidate.
	majority: For majority voting.
	n-of-m: Includes vote for 1, i.e., 1-of-m.
	other: Used when the vote variation type is not included in this enumeration.
	plurality: For plurality voting.
	proportional: For proportional voting.
	range: For range voting.
	rcv: For ranked choice voting.
	super-majority: For super majority voting.

BallotDefinition.WriteInPosition.description: Response area for representing a particular candidate, e.g. John Smith hand printed. It inherits the properties of BoundedObject.

H.description: Height in ballot format measurement units.

SelectionRequired.description: Whether a selection in an OptionPosition is required in order to count the write-in. Assumed to be false if not present.

Sheet.description: The ballot sheet the bounded object appears on. Sheets start at 1 and increase monotonically. Does not apply to mCDFArea, or global fiducials.

Side.description: The side of the sheet of paper the bounded object appears.

W.description: Width in ballot format measurement units.

Y.description: Y-coordinate for locating a bounded object (top left anchor).

H.description: Height in ballot format measurement units.

Sheet.description: The ballot sheet the bounded object appears on. Sheets start at 1 and increase monotonically. Does not apply to mCDFArea, or global fiducials.

Side.description: The side of the sheet of paper the bounded object appears.

Symbology.description: The name of the symbology used.

W.description: Width in ballot format measurement units.

X.description: X-coordinate for locating a bounded object (top left anchor).

Y.description: Y-coordinate for locating a bounded object (top left anchor).
